newsitem.title: IRAN: Iranian literacy rate put at 80 percent.
newsitem.headline: Iranian literacy rate put at 80 percent.

text.p: Around 80 percent of Iran's 60 million population can read and write compared with 62 percent 10 years ago, a government statistician said.
Abbas-Ali Zali, head of the government statistics centre, was quoted on Tuesday as saying the literacy rate in cities was 85.7 percent and in rural areas 69.6 percent.
Quoting a November 1996 census, he told Iranian newspapers Iran's population was 60,055,488 and the average age was 19 years four months.
